Predicted Means for Linear and Semiparametric Models

Source: R/predictmeans-package.R
predictmeans-package.Rd

This package provides functions to diagnose and make inferences from linear, generalized linear, mixed and semiparametric models, such as those obtained from 'aov', 'lm', 'glm', 'gls', 'lme', 'lmer', 'glmer', 'glmmTMB', 'gam' and 'semireg'. Inferences include predicted means and standard errors, contrasts, multiple comparisons, permutation tests, adjusted R-square and graphs (autoplot()). Vignettes (browseVignettes("predictmeans")) show worked examples. For AI assistants and scripted use, system.file("llms-context.md", package = "predictmeans") gives a compact description of the result tables, defaults and common recipes.

Details

Package:predictmeans
Type:Package
License:GPL (>= 2)

Workflow

What predictmeans aims for

  • Defaults chosen on evidence (simulation, literature): Kenward-Roger df and adjusted SEs for REML lmer fits; permutation p-values \((b + 1)/(B + 1)\), never 0; Genstat-style stratum SEs for aov models with Error() strata.

  • Checked against outside references: SAS PROC MIXED and Genstat runs (dev/sas, dev/genstat in the package sources), pbkrtest, nlme and emmeans, in tests with stated tolerances.

  • Works across lm, glm, aov, lmer, glmer, lme, gls, glmmTMB, gam and semireg fits; when a result cannot be computed correctly it stops with a clear message.

  • Advice triggered by this fit and data, read with advice.

  • Results are the same for any ncore.

References

Welham, S., Cullis, B., Gogel, B., Gilmour, A., & Thompson, R. (2004), Prediction in linear mixed models, Australian and New Zealand Journal of Statistics, 46(3), 325-347.
